notes.title: Demo v1.6.1 Update (Hotfix)
notes.content: [h2]Voice / Log[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where clicking [b]Backlog / Play button / Options / Volume slider[/b] could also [b]advance text[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Stabilized the [b]play button[/b] (no more triggers from blank areas; improved hitbox and input handling).[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed [b]speaker name overlay[/b] when opening Options during story (layer order adjusted).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]parameter icon offset[/b] on hover over training buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Eased [b]chapter goal text tightness[/b] (tracking / separators tuned).[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed minor [b]text/line-break glitches[/b] and [b]typos[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]animations could stop on Save/Load[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep the feedback coming via [b]reviews[/b] or the [b]forums[/b]—it helps a lot. Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.6 Update Notice
notes.content:
[h3]■ Highlights[/h3][p]・Line adjustments
・Reviewed the morning/night one-liners to match “her state of the day,” cleaned up contradictory phrasing, and improved readability.
・Minor tweaks to key chapter lines (softened stiff wording and chose vocabulary that conveys feelings).[/p][p][/p][h3]■ UI Updates[/h3][p]・Refreshed the status display from numeric gauges to [b]icons + tier labels[/b].
・Unified chapter goals and weekly mini-goals into [b]single-line display[/b] for better readability.
・Changed action preview chips from numbers to [b]“verbs + arrows (— / ↑ / ↑↑ / ↑↑↑)”[/b].[/p][p]Unification and polish of terminology across languages (EN/ZH-CN/KO), adjusting inconsistent terms and stiff translations.[/p][p][/p][h3]■ Bug Fixes[/h3][p]・Fixed some tooltip/chip display glitches (missing symbols/brackets).
・Corrected minor layout/line-break issues and typos.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback powers the next update.
Please keep playing and sharing your thoughts.
Warm reviews are a great encouragement![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Notice (ver1.5 — UI Improvements / Backlog & Auto-Advance)
notes.content:
[h3][b]What’s in this update[/b]
[/h3][h3]・Reworked UI layout and font sizes in the raising part to improve readability.
・Added a [b]Backlog[/b] feature ([b]voice playback from the log[/b] supported).
・Implemented [b]Auto-Advance[/b] ([b]auto-stops at important scenes[/b]).
・Surfaced on-screen buttons: [b]\[Options] \[Fast Skip] \[Auto][/b].
・Added [b]Save/Load[/b] to [b]\[Options][/b], so you can use them anytime in-game.
・You can now open [b]Auto / Skip / Backlog / Options[/b] even during ADV scenes.[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]What’s next[/b]
[/h3][h3]・Bug fixes
・Further UI tuning (text size / readability)
・Fine-tuning of lines and direction[/h3][p][/p][p]Your feedback directly helps us make a better game.
Please keep playing and let us know what you think.
Warm impressions and reviews are also very welcome![/p]

notes.title: DEMO Version 1.4 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Main Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Text Speed Settings[/b]: Added Fast Mode and Auto-Read options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Protection Mode[/b]: Important story events will no longer be skipped.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Improvements[/b]: Fixed blurry text and improved resolution. More font visibility updates are planned.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed Unnecessary Options[/b]: Simplified confusing items such as “Dash.”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faster Daily Cycle[/b]: With Fast Mode and Skip (read text), replays are smoother.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue Adjustments[/b]: Some lines were revised to better match the characters’ feelings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BGM Adjustments[/b]: Unified music atmosphere in certain scenes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multilingual Fonts[/b]: Each language now loads its own font for better readability.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Coming Soon[/h3][list][*][p]Further improvements to font size and UI visibility[/p][/*][*][p]A new tutorial event at the beginning of the story[/p][/*][*][p]Additional tweaks to make gameplay more comfortable[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback is invaluable in shaping this game.
We’d love to hear your thoughts and impressions—thank you for your support![/p]
